meta.notes: Tiered source list. Tier A is primary signal (wires, regulator news, Google News queries, X bridges, company pressrooms) polled aggressively for speed. Tier B is commentary and analysis polled less often. Newsletters and X accounts that need an email-to-RSS or twitter-to-RSS bridge carry feed_bridge_required: true and must be configured against a bridge service (rss.app, kill-the-newsletter.com, Feedbin, nitter).

validation.method: URL presence and historical feed stability review
validation.summary: Curated from 22 to 45 sources. Added LawSites, Above the Law, 3 Geeks, UK trade press, Bloomberg Law, Thomson Reuters Institute, Judicial Office, DSIT, Crunchbase News, 7 Google News query feeds, 11 company pressrooms, 3 substacks, and 7 X bridge placeholders.

tiers.A: Primary signal. Poll every 15-30 minutes. Low-latency feeds, keyword queries, pressrooms, regulators, social bridges.
tiers.B: Commentary and analysis. Poll every 2-6 hours. Reporters, long-form, trade press, research outlets, company marketing blogs.
